The problem can be exacerbated under a substantial proportion of free allocation, a fixed (or inflexible) cap as well as uncertain regulatory ambitions, particularly in emerging economies under a variety of uncertainty. Recognizing the regulator's role in dealing with firms' expectations (or concerns) and facilitating innovation investments, we discuss potential alternative systems (e.g., with auction and flexible supply) for decarbonization that incorporate flexibility in terms of innovation timing and realized costs.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们解释了在碳限额交易中，由基于预期的损失厌恶强化的禀赋效应存在时，代理人的交易行为和市场结果。基于Kőszegi和Rabin（2006）的具有前瞻性参考点的模型，我们展示了企业对高未来合规成本的担忧（通过损失厌恶和不确定性）如何导致配额支付意愿与接受意愿之间的差距。这导致配额交易受限，并偏离社会合意路径。在大量免费分配、固定（或不灵活）的限额以及不确定的监管雄心的情况下，这一问题可能加剧，尤其是在各种不确定性下的新兴经济体中。认识到监管机构在处理企业预期（或担忧）和促进创新投资方面的作用，我们讨论了脱碳的潜在替代系统（例如，拍卖和灵活供应），这些系统在创新时机和实现成本方面具有灵活性。

articles.title_en: Green electricity product menu design for retailers without knowing consumer environmental awareness
articles.title_cn: 未知消费者环保意识下的零售商绿色电力产品菜单设计
articles.abstract_en: Adverse selection problem due to asymmetry of consumer environmental awareness (CEA) could reduce electricity retailer's profit and obstructs renewable energy (RE) consumption. This study analyzes mechanism design problem of retailer constricted by RE consumption quota to incentive consumers display true CEA in competitive retail market. Based on principal-agent theory, we develop an extended principal-agent model with the addition of an RE consumption quota constraint to design a green electricity product menu which includes the green level, the price and electric quantity. Influence of information symmetry and quota setting on product attributes, retailer's profit, consumer utility, RE consumption is analyzed, and results show that: (1) Compare to symmetric information, under asymmetric information, green level of product provided to consumers with CEA (denoted as C1) distorts upward, information rent is greater than zero when quota is large, while green level of product provided to consumers without CEA (denoted as C2) distorts downward, with no information rent. (2) Under asymmetric information, unit environmental premium (UEP) of green electricity positively relates to proportion of C1, CEA level, and incremental WTP, and reaches the maximum value at a certain quota. (3) Under asymmetric information, retailer's profit and RE consumption positively relates to proportion of C1, and CEA level. (4) Under asymmetric information, quota difference could contribute to improve retail service quality under competitive retail market, and RE consumption elevation.
articles.abstract_cn: 消费者环保意识（CEA）不对称导致的逆向选择问题可能降低电力零售商的利润，并阻碍可再生能源（RE）消费。本研究分析了在竞争性零售市场中，受可再生能源消费配额约束的零售商激励消费者显示真实CEA的机制设计问题。基于委托代理理论，我们构建了一个扩展的委托代理模型，并加入可再生能源消费配额约束，以设计包含绿色水平、价格和电量的绿色电力产品菜单。分析了信息对称性和配额设定对产品属性、零售商利润、消费者效用和可再生能源消费的影响，结果表明：（1）与对称信息相比，在不对称信息下，提供给具有CEA消费者（记为C1）的产品绿色水平向上扭曲，当配额较大时信息租金大于零，而提供给无CEA消费者（记为C2）的产品绿色水平向下扭曲，且无信息租金。（2）在不对称信息下，绿色电力的单位环境溢价（UEP）与C1比例、CEA水平和增量支付意愿正相关，并在特定配额处达到最大值。（3）在不对称信息下，零售商利润和可再生能源消费与C1比例和CEA水平正相关。（4）在不对称信息下，配额差异有助于提高竞争性零售市场下的零售服务质量，并促进可再生能源消费提升。

articles.title_en: Purchase or generate? An analysis of inter-fuel substitution and electricity generation in Japanese manufacturing plants
articles.title_cn: 购买还是自产？日本制造业工厂燃料间替代与电力生产的分析
articles.abstract_en: As the manufacturing industry is one of the largest contributors to global emissions, decarbonization of the production line is a key aspect in the fight against climate change. In this study, we examine the level of substitutability between fossil fuel and electricity. Using data on Japanese plants from 2004 to 2020, we estimate the elasticity of substitution between the two inputs and find that a 1 % increase in electricity prices results in a 6.55 % increase in fossil fuel consumption. Our paper also contributes to explaining mechanisms behind inter-fuel substitution, with a special focus on electricity and fossil fuel through cogeneration. We find that substitutability is highly sector-dependent, and identify the pulp & paper, iron & steel, chemicals and cement to be sectors with substitution capacity. These sectors see an increase in their electricity generation, the magnitude of which is estimated between 0.004 % (cement) to 0.23 % (iron & steel). Iron & steel and cement also increase their consumption of coal to power generators by 0.06 % and 0.005 %, respectively. Our findings suggest the need for taxation of both fuel and electricity together, to discourage further substitution attempts that would hinder decarbonization efforts.
articles.abstract_cn: 由于制造业是全球排放的最大贡献者之一，生产线的脱碳是应对气候变化的关键方面。在本研究中，我们考察了化石燃料与电力之间的可替代性水平。利用2004年至2020年日本工厂的数据，我们估计了这两种投入之间的替代弹性，发现电价每上涨1%，化石燃料消费量将增加6.55%。我们的论文还致力于解释燃料间替代背后的机制，特别关注通过热电联产实现的电力与化石燃料之间的替代。我们发现，可替代性高度依赖于行业，并确定纸浆与造纸、钢铁、化工和水泥为具有替代能力的行业。这些行业的电力生产有所增加，其增幅估计在0.004%（水泥）至0.23%（钢铁）之间。钢铁和水泥行业还分别增加了0.06%和0.005%的煤炭消费用于发电。我们的研究结果表明，需要对燃料和电力同时征税，以阻止进一步阻碍脱碳努力的替代尝试。

articles.title_en: Does environmental decentralisation improve ESG performance? Evidence from listed companies in China
articles.title_cn: 环境分权是否提升了ESG表现？来自中国上市公司的证据
articles.abstract_en: Environmental management systems are essential for promoting sustainable development. Rational distribution of environmental management responsibilities among governmental entities is a fundamental requirement and institutional framework. China's Direct Reporting of Environmental Statistics for National Key Supervision Enterprises (DRES) policy is a reform initiative that is intended to recalibrate environmental decentralisation to intensify environmental oversight. Using manually-collected data from key A-share listed companies from 2009 to 2021, this study employs a difference-in-differences model to evaluate the impact of the DRES policy on corporate environmental, social and governance (ESG) performance. The main findings are as fourfold. (1) The DRES policy significantly enhances corporate ESG performance. (2) Regarding policy transmission pathways, it empowers enterprises to systematically improve their ESG performance through concept, terminal, source and voluntary governance. (3) Heterogeneity analysis reveals that the policy's efficacy is particularly pronounced in resource-based regions, among enterprises with low managerial myopia and limited analyst attention and within non-state-owned enterprises. (4) Economic consequence testing indicates that enterprises' improved ESG performance can enhance total factor productivity but concurrently increases enterprises' risk. Finally, the study proposes corresponding policy recommendations such as improving the incentive and restraint mechanisms of environmental management and implementing differentiated environmental governance strategies.
articles.abstract_cn: 环境管理体系对于促进可持续发展至关重要。政府实体之间环境管理职责的合理分配是基本要求和制度框架。中国的国家重点监控企业环境统计直报（DRES）政策是一项改革举措，旨在重新调整环境分权以加强环境监管。利用2009年至2021年A股重点上市公司的手工收集数据，本研究采用双重差分模型评估DRES政策对企业环境、社会和治理（ESG）表现的影响。主要发现有四点。（1）DRES政策显著提升了企业ESG表现。（2）在政策传导路径方面，它通过理念、末端、源头和自愿治理，使企业能够系统地改善其ESG表现。（3）异质性分析显示，该政策的效果在资源型地区、管理短视程度低和分析师关注度低的企业以及非国有企业中尤为显著。（4）经济后果检验表明，企业ESG表现的提升可以提高全要素生产率，但同时增加了企业的风险。最后，研究提出了相应的政策建议，如完善环境管理的激励约束机制和实施差异化的环境治理策略。

articles.title_en: Modeling daily energy use in British homes amidst the electricity market crisis: Insights from smart meter and socio-technical data
articles.title_cn: 电力市场危机期间英国家庭日常能源使用建模：来自智能电表和社会技术数据的洞察
articles.abstract_en: This study examines the factors influencing daily electricity use in UK homes during the electricity market crisis. Using data from smart meters and socio-technical sources, the research identifies key drivers of electricity consumption, such as household size, weather conditions, and appliance use. Results from a sample of British homes, analyzed through linear mixed effects modeling, show that households with more occupants, greater number of adults, higher heating settings, and fewer energy-saving efforts consume more energy. Weather, housing type, and air conditioning also play significant roles. The findings highlight the importance of integrating smart meter data with other sources to develop effective energy-saving strategies and inform targeted conservation policies.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究考察了电力市场危机期间影响英国家庭日常用电的因素。利用智能电表和社会技术来源的数据，研究识别了电力消耗的关键驱动因素，如家庭规模、天气条件和电器使用。通过对英国家庭样本进行线性混合效应建模分析，结果显示，居住人数更多、成年人数量更多、供暖设置更高以及节能努力更少的家庭消耗更多能源。天气、住房类型和空调也发挥重要作用。研究结果强调了将智能电表数据与其他来源整合以制定有效节能策略和为针对性保护政策提供信息的重要性。

articles.title_en: Government environmental signals, government–Enterprise collusion and corporate pollution transfer
articles.title_cn: 政府环境信号、政企合谋与企业污染转移
articles.abstract_en: To optimize the implementation of environmental policies and foster green development in China's economy, it is crucial to be vigilant about corporate pollution transfer behaviors and regulate collusive relationships between local governments and enterprises. This study introduces a theoretical four-way game model to explore the impact of corporate pollution transfer, considering environmental regulation by the central government and third-party oversight, as well as collusion between local governments and firms. Using data from China's A-share listed companies from 2007 to 2021, this study examines whether polluting firms engage in pollution transfer in response to environmental policies, with the Low-carbon City Pilot Policy (LCPP) serving as a proxy for government environmental signals. The findings reveal that the LCPP generally affects corporate pollution transfer. Mechanism analysis shows that the LCPP reduces pollution transfer through both formal and informal regulatory channels. Heterogeneity analysis further indicates that the pollution transfer effect is more pronounced in local state-owned enterprises, companies with a history of financial fraud, and highly polluting industries. Additionally, the study highlights that collusion between the government and enterprises promotes corporate pollution transfer, while changes in local government personnel disrupt this collusion and reduce pollution transfer. The research also identifies the supply chain as a key transmission path for pollution transfer. This work not only advances theoretical and empirical understanding of corporate behavior under environmental policy influence but also enriches research on government-enterprise relations and the effectiveness of environmental policies. It offers theoretical support and policy recommendations for constructing a rational green economic development system in China.
articles.abstract_cn: 为优化环境政策实施并促进中国经济绿色发展，必须警惕企业污染转移行为并规范地方政府与企业之间的合谋关系。本研究引入一个理论四方博弈模型，在考虑中央政府环境规制和第三方监督以及地方政府与企业合谋的情况下，探讨企业污染转移的影响。利用中国A股上市公司2007年至2021年的数据，本研究考察污染企业是否响应环境政策进行污染转移，以低碳城市试点政策（LCPP）作为政府环境信号的代理变量。研究发现，LCPP总体上影响企业污染转移。机制分析表明，LCPP通过正式和非正式规制渠道减少污染转移。异质性分析进一步表明，污染转移效应在地方国有企业、有财务欺诈历史的公司以及高污染行业中更为显著。此外，研究强调政企合谋促进企业污染转移，而地方政府人事变动会打破这种合谋并减少污染转移。研究还识别出供应链是污染转移的关键传导路径。这项工作不仅推进了环境政策影响下企业行为的理论与实证理解，还丰富了政企关系和环境政策有效性的研究。它为构建中国合理的绿色经济发展体系提供了理论支持和政策建议。

articles.title_en: Sustainable energy practices and cryptocurrency market behavior
articles.title_cn: 可持续能源实践与加密货币市场行为
articles.abstract_en: We examine the effects of energy usage on the return, volatility and jump processes in the Bitcoin (BTC) and Ethereum (ETH) markets. Our main finding indicates that while BTC returns respond significantly to changes in electricity consumption, the effect of electricity consumption on ETH returns is negligible. We attribute this discrepancy to BTC's relative energy inefficiency, which contrasts with ETH's commitment to transitioning to a more energy-efficient mining protocol over our sample period. Additionally, we show that the effect of electricity consumption on cryptocurrencies is mitigated by media coverage and policy uncertainty regarding the state of the economy, environment, and cryptocurrency markets. Our results suggest that when trading cryptocurrencies, investors consider their relative energy efficiency and price electricity consumption differently, highlighting the influence of the transition towards more sustainable energy practices on investor preferences and investment decisions in cryptocurrency markets.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考察了能源使用对比特币（BTC）和以太坊（ETH）市场收益率、波动率和跳跃过程的影响。我们的主要发现表明，虽然BTC收益率对电力消耗的变化有显著反应，但电力消耗对ETH收益率的影响可以忽略不计。我们将这种差异归因于BTC相对能源效率低下，这与ETH在我们的样本期内承诺转向更节能的挖矿协议形成对比。此外，我们表明，电力消耗对加密货币的影响受到媒体关注以及关于经济、环境和加密货币市场状况的政策不确定性的缓解。我们的结果表明，在交易加密货币时，投资者会考虑其相对能源效率并对电力消耗进行不同定价，凸显了向更可持续能源实践过渡对投资者偏好和加密货币市场投资决策的影响。

articles.title_en: Climate policy uncertainty and energy transition: Evidence from prefecture-level cities in China
articles.title_cn: 气候政策不确定性与能源转型：来自中国地级市的证据
articles.abstract_en: Extreme weather has become a severe threat to humanity today, with a major blow to energy systems. Energy transformation has become a significant trend in global development, and China has the responsibility and obligation to combat climate change. This paper examines the impact of climate policy uncertainty on energy transformation in China at prefecture-level cities level. A new climate policy uncertainty index and a new measure of energy transition are proposed. The results indicate that climate policy uncertainty has a negative impact on the energy transition. The result still holds after a series of robustness tests. Further analysis shows that the adverse impact of climate policy uncertainty on the energy transition weakens with more proactive government behavior and greater public environmental concerns. For cities that are economically underdeveloped, non-resource oriented and officials’ promotion pressure mounting, the disincentive to energy transition is greater when climate policy uncertainty rises.
articles.abstract_cn: 极端天气已成为当今人类面临的严重威胁，对能源系统造成重大打击。能源转型已成为全球发展的重要趋势，中国有责任和义务应对气候变化。本文在地级市层面考察了气候政策不确定性对中国能源转型的影响。提出了一个新的气候政策不确定性指数和一种新的能源转型衡量方法。结果表明，气候政策不确定性对能源转型有负面影响。在一系列稳健性检验后，这一结果仍然成立。进一步分析表明，随着政府行为更加积极和公众环境关注度提高，气候政策不确定性对能源转型的不利影响会减弱。对于经济欠发达、非资源导向型以及官员晋升压力较大的城市，当气候政策不确定性上升时，对能源转型的抑制作用更大。

articles.title_en: Do petrol prices affect inflation and inflation expectations? Evidence from New Zealand
articles.title_cn: 汽油价格是否影响通货膨胀和通胀预期？来自新西兰的证据
articles.abstract_en: Due to their high visibility, petrol prices shape households' inflation expectations. This paper investigates the dynamic effects of petrol price shocks on one- and five-year inflation expectations in New Zealand; effects on headline and core inflation are also analyzed. Estimating partially identified structural vector autoregression models using Bayesian techniques, we show that petrol price shocks had a slightly delayed but persistent effect on one-year inflation expectations, whereas five-year inflation expectations were largely insensitive to these shocks. We also show that headline inflation increased immediately in response to petrol price shocks, while core inflation remained unaffected. Counterfactual analysis reveals that inflation and inflation expectations would have been higher in the absence of petrol price shocks during the second half of 2020. The results underscore the importance of petrol prices in influencing households' short-term inflation expectations, offering valuable insights for policymakers focused on managing the cost of living and inflation expectations in New Zealand.
articles.abstract_cn: 由于汽油价格的高可见性，它们塑造了家庭的通胀预期。本文研究了汽油价格冲击对新西兰一年期和五年期通胀预期的动态影响；同时分析了其对总体通胀和核心通胀的影响。通过使用贝叶斯技术估计部分识别的结构向量自回归模型，我们表明汽油价格冲击对一年期通胀预期有轻微延迟但持续的影响，而五年期通胀预期对这些冲击基本不敏感。我们还表明，总体通胀对汽油价格冲击立即上升，而核心通胀未受影响。反事实分析显示，在2020年下半年，如果没有汽油价格冲击，通胀和通胀预期将会更高。结果强调了汽油价格在影响家庭短期通胀预期中的重要性，为专注于管理新西兰生活成本和通胀预期的政策制定者提供了有价值的见解。

articles.title_en: Oil price shocks and bond risk premia: Evidence from a panel of 15 countries
articles.title_cn: 油价冲击与债券风险溢价：来自15个国家面板的证据
articles.abstract_en: We study the effect of oil price shocks on bond risk premia. Based on Baumeister and Hamilton (2019), we identify the different sources of oil price shocks using a structural vector autoregressive (SVAR) model of the global market for crude oil. These structural factors are then used as unspanned factors in an affine term structure model based on the representation of Joslin et al. (2014). This is done for a total of 15 countries. Unspanned factors are responsible for most of the variability in bond risk premia for short holding periods, while spanned factors dominate the variance decomposition for longer holding periods. In both cases, global oil supply and global economic activity are clearly the most important unspanned shocks. A historical decomposition around the outbreak of the COVID-19 crisis shows the clear influence of global economic activity shocks during the months of February and March 2020, increasing bond risk premia significantly.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了油价冲击对债券风险溢价的影响。基于Baumeister和Hamilton（2019），我们使用全球原油市场的结构向量自回归（SVAR）模型识别油价冲击的不同来源。然后，这些结构因子被用作基于Joslin等人（2014）表示的仿射期限结构模型中的非跨越因子。我们对总共15个国家进行了这一分析。非跨越因子解释了短期持有期债券风险溢价的大部分变动，而跨越因子在较长持有期的方差分解中占主导地位。在这两种情况下，全球石油供应和全球经济活动显然是最重要的非跨越冲击。围绕COVID-19危机爆发的历史分解显示，在2020年二月和三月期间，全球经济活动的冲击产生了明显影响，显著提高了债券风险溢价。

articles.title_en: From bytes to green: The impact of supply chain digitization on corporate green innovation
articles.title_cn: 从字节到绿色：供应链数字化对企业绿色创新的影响
articles.abstract_en: A significant share of corporate carbon emissions stems from the supply chain, necessitating an analysis of how supply chain digitalization influences green innovation in the digital age. This paper examines this impact using data from Chinese listed firms (2012−2022). Theoretically, the study posits that supply chain digitalization facilitates green innovation through two primary mechanisms: enhancing upstream and downstream integration and boosting the internal efficiency of supply chain management at nodal enterprises. Empirically, a quasi-natural experiment leveraging the Supply Chain Innovation and Application Pilot Program serves as an exogenous shock. Key findings include: (1) Supply chain digitalization enhances corporate green innovation, with robust results across various tests. (2) The effect is mainly driven by enhanced supply chain integration—more from supplier concentration than customer concentration—and improved internal supply chain management efficiency. (3) The impact has three characteristics: Quality-first Effect, Crowding-in Effect and Persistence Effect. Specifically, supply chain digitalization mainly boosts high-quality green invention patent applications without crowding-out other non-green innovation, while also positively influences sustained green innovation. (4) Supply chain digitalization primarily enhances green innovation in End-of-Pipe and Process Control Technologies, with limited effects on Pollution Prevention at Source.
articles.abstract_cn: 企业碳排放的很大一部分来自供应链，因此在数字时代，有必要分析供应链数字化如何影响绿色创新。本文利用中国上市公司数据（2012−2022年）考察了这一影响。理论上，研究认为供应链数字化通过两个主要机制促进绿色创新：增强上下游整合和提高节点企业内部供应链管理效率。实证上，利用供应链创新与应用试点作为外生冲击的准自然实验。主要发现包括：（1）供应链数字化提升了企业绿色创新，且在各种测试中结果稳健。（2）这一效应主要由供应链整合增强驱动——更多来自供应商集中度而非客户集中度——以及内部供应链管理效率的提升。（3）该影响具有三个特征：质量优先效应、挤入效应和持续性效应。具体而言，供应链数字化主要促进高质量绿色发明专利申请，且不挤出其他非绿色创新，同时积极影响持续绿色创新。（4）供应链数字化主要增强末端治理和过程控制技术的绿色创新，对源头污染防治的影响有限。

articles.title_en: The wealth effect of the US net zero announcement
articles.title_cn: 美国净零排放公告的财富效应
articles.abstract_en: This study investigates the impact of announcements relating to climate change mitigation in the US on the Energy Select Sector ETF (XLE), starting with the US president's net zero emissions announcement on 22 April 2021. We use options market data, in addition to ETF market data, to disaggregate the news effect and value effect of the announcement, finding a positive news effect ($1.65 billion) but a negative value effect (−$2.02 billion). The novel approach proposed by Barraclough et al. (2013) is adopted to identify traders' perceived probability of the achievement of net zero emissions as perceived by investors, finding that investors assigned a 30.9 % probability. Given the difficult journey of the passage of the net zero bill through Congress, we also examine the investors' perceived probability of achievement of later initiatives, as well as their news and value effects. Estimation around the introduction of the Inflation Reduction Act (IRA) in Congress on 27 October 2021 shows a positive news effect ($824.61 million) and an almost analogous, negative value effect (−$2.32 billion). The news effect is a result of the signal to the market that reduces policy uncertainty and enables fossil fuel firms to plan with greater certainty the transition to clean energy and the value effect comes from the fact that some reserves may not be able to be extracted and some assets will be stranded. This study finds if the net zero emissions announcement is successfully enacted as legislation, the value of XLE would be 96.90 % of its current value while a failure to become legislation leads to a rise in the value of XLE to reach 106.90 % of its current value.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了美国与减缓气候变化相关的公告对能源精选板块ETF（XLE）的影响，从美国总统于22年四月2021日发布的净零排放公告开始。我们使用期权市场数据以及ETF市场数据，将公告的新闻效应和价值效应进行分解，发现正的新闻效应（1.65亿美元）但负的价值效应（2.02亿美元）。采用Barraclough等人（2013）提出的新颖方法，以识别交易者对实现净零排放的感知概率，发现投资者赋予的概率为30.9%。鉴于净零排放法案在国会通过的艰难历程，我们还考察了投资者对后续举措的感知实现概率及其新闻效应和价值效应。对27年十月2021日国会引入《通胀削减法案》（IRA）前后的估计显示，正的新闻效应（824.61亿美元）和几乎类似规模的负价值效应（2.32亿美元）。新闻效应源于向市场发出的信号，该信号降低了政策不确定性，使化石燃料公司能够更确定地规划向清洁能源的过渡，而价值效应则源于某些储量可能无法开采以及部分资产将被搁置。本研究发现，如果净零排放公告成功立法，XLE的价值将为其当前价值的96.90%，而若未能立法，XLE的价值将上升至其当前价值的106.90%。

articles.title_en: A comment on “Assessing the effectiveness of energy efficiency measures in the residential sector gas consumption through dynamic treatment effects: Evidence from England and Wales”
articles.title_cn: 对“通过动态处理效应评估住宅部门燃气消耗中能效措施的有效性：来自英格兰和威尔士的证据”一文的评论
articles.abstract_en: In our previous publication “Assessing the effectiveness of energy efficiency measures in the residential sector gas consumption through dynamic treatment effects: Evidence from England and Wales”, we analyzed the impact of the implementation of energy efficiency (EE) measures, in particular loft insulation and cavity walls, on household gas consumption up to five years after installation. Upon review, we realized that our phrasing, specifically the term “energy savings disappear,” might have led to misunderstandings regarding our findings. In this commentary, we clarify that our results indicate reductions in the level of energy (gas) savings achieved, two to four years after the implementation of the energy efficiency measures. The adoption of EE measures is associated with significant reductions in household residential gas consumption one year after their implementation, as we expressed in Peñasco and Anadon (2023). However, the level of savings decreases four years after the retrofitting of cavity wall insulation measures and two years after the installation of loft insulation, generating increases in consumption with respect to the maximum level of savings achieved, i.e., rebounds in consumption. We find that, after five years, energy savings from loft installations are still positive, in the range of 4–5 % compared to the control group—a level of savings that represents a rebound of about 20–25 %, when compared to the maximum level of savings that occurs two years after installation. For cavity walls, after five years gas savings are in the range of 6–9 % compared to the control group, with rebounds of about 10–13 % compared to the maximum savings. This clarification is crucial to prevent a misinterpretation of the results in future research and policy making.
articles.abstract_cn: 在我们先前发表的论文“通过动态处理效应评估住宅部门燃气消耗中能效措施的有效性：来自英格兰和威尔士的证据”中，我们分析了能效（EE）措施的实施，特别是阁楼保温和空腔墙体保温，对家庭燃气消耗在安装后长达五年的影响。经审查，我们意识到我们的措辞，特别是“能源节约消失”这一术语，可能导致对我们的研究结果产生误解。在这篇评论中，我们澄清我们的结果表明，在能效措施实施后两到四年，所实现的能源（燃气）节约水平有所下降。正如我们在Peñasco和Anadon（2023）中所表述的，采取能效措施与实施一年后家庭住宅燃气消耗的显著减少相关。然而，在空腔墙体保温改造后四年和阁楼保温安装后两年，节约水平下降，相对于所达到的最大节约水平产生消费增加，即消费反弹。我们发现，五年后，阁楼保温的能源节约仍然为正，相对于对照组在4-5%的范围内——这一节约水平相对于安装两年后出现的最大节约水平，代表了约20-25%的反弹。对于空腔墙体，五年后燃气节约相对于对照组在6-9%的范围内，相对于最大节约的反弹约为10-13%。这一澄清对于防止未来研究和政策制定中对结果的误解至关重要。
